theta.definition: n. the 8th letter of the Greek alphabet
theta.translation: n. 希腊字母的第八字

theta wave.translation: [医] θ波(频率为每秒4-7次的脑电波)

thetas.definition: n. the 8th letter of the Greek alphabet
thetas.translation: n. 希蜡字母的第八字；时间递耗值

thetic.translation: a. 武断的；独断的；扬音节开始的

thetine.definition:
n. Any one of a series of complex basic sulphur compounds
   analogous to the sulphines.
thetine.translation: [化] 噻亭; 硫代三烃基内酯

thetis.definition: n. (Greek mythology) one of the 50 Nereids; mother of Achilles by Peleus
thetis.translation: n. [希腊神话]西蒂斯（海神Nereus的女儿）

thetted.translation: (thet 的过去时) n. (Thet)人名；(缅)德
